items.q: They have it right now, Von Freeman, he has his sessions out here.

ctx.x: Well, that's an old South Side tradition, isn't it? Entertainers gathering in some place after hours on on or off nights.
Right, right. They have it right now, Von Freeman, he has his sessions out here.
I was just over to his house.
